priceBands.note: Rare weapon-enhancement modules (Enhanced Resonance Module, Advanced Restructure Component). The Overseas station opens -40% to +146% in 13% steps; the client table says 50% to 250% with a 13.3% increment. Observed 2026-11-07.

sections.title: Listing
items: A non-refundable fee is charged when an item is listed. It is paid in Gold and equals the listing's value in Universal Crystals, price times quantity; the Pass takes 20% off. The fee does not depend on Trade Station level.
Up to 6 items can be listed by default. The Pass unlocks more listing slots.
A listing expires after 24 hours, and the stack returns by in-game mail. The client sets that window in DA_TradeLine.
Multiple units of one listing sell individually and settle instantly; a buyer does not need the whole stack.
Equipment Expansion Packs cannot be listed.

sections.title: Trading
items: A purchase is matched against the lowest current listing of the same item.
A 5% fee in Universal Crystals is taken from the seller's proceeds on every completed sale.
The station closes every day from 00:00 to 01:00 server time.
An item with a review period can only be purchased once the period ends; the client sets that period to 2 hours.
Equipment and Relics bind to the buyer on purchase.

sections.title: Active status
items: Players with low activity and a low Apex CS count as inactive, and their listings are invisible to other players.
